observations: Photo 0 shows a vintage-style sewing machine on a tiled floor.
The machine is beige/grey with a foot pedal and coiled power cord.
The machine appears used, with visible dirt, grime, and wear on the body and pedal.
The needle and presser foot are visible, and the machine is not in operation.
No power plug is visible; the cord is coiled and connected to a black pedal.
The background includes a yellow and white patterned object (possibly a bag or cushion) and part of a metal stand with wheels.

claims.claim: Ideal Topstar manual sewing machine available for sale.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this clearly enough to read.

claims.claim: Japanese made, the motor runs smooth. All accessories and the original manual, never serviced because nothing ever went wrong.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The machine may not be functional or may have internal damage.
risks.proof: A video showing the machine powered on, needle moving, and foot pedal operation.

risks.risk: The power cord may be damaged or non-functional.
risks.proof: Close-up of the power cord and plug, showing no fraying or damage, and a test of the plug.

risks.risk: The machine may have missing parts or accessories (e.g., bobbins, needles, manual).
risks.proof: Photo showing all included accessories laid out next to the machine.

proof_requests: Video of the machine in operation with foot pedal.
Close-up of the power cord and plug.
Photo of all included accessories (bobbins, needles, manual, etc.).
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
